profile.subtitleJa: シリア王ベン・ハダドが住む都として記されます。
profile.summaryJa: アサは主の宮と王宮の宝物から銀と金を取り出し、ダマスコに住むシリア王ベン・ハダドへ使者を送ります。

facts.textJa: シリア軍はユダとエルサレムを攻め、戦利品をダマスコの王へ送ります。
アハズはシリア王の手に渡され、多くの捕虜がダマスコへ連れ去られます。
アハズは、彼を打ち負かしたと考えたダマスコの神々に犠牲をささげます。

profile.modernLocationJa: 古代ダマスコは現代のシリアの首都ダマスカスと結びつく都市名です。古代の市域と現代の市街を同一の範囲とはみなしません。
profile.historicalRoleJa: シリアの王が住む都市として、ユダ王アサの外交の相手先に挙げられます。
profile.locationNoteJa: 地名は都市を指します。現代の市街中心の点を古代都市の確定地点として扱う根拠はここでは確認していません。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the LORD’s house and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben Hadad king of Syria, who lived at Damascus, saying,

At the end of the year, the army of the Syrians came up against him. They came to Judah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

Therefore the LORD his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria. They struck him, and carried away from him a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Damascus. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.

For he sacrificed to the gods of Damascus which had defeated him. He said, “Because the gods of the kings of Syria helped them, I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me.” But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
